purpose: Measure reward-only adaptation after unannounced goal reversal and return, while retaining learned event priorities
methods: new archived-priority-bank with reward-only change recognition
metrics: online training reward early/late each phase
number of context-bank regimes and switches
model-bound checksum and exact replay of reward choices

mechanism.change_detection_threshold: frozen in source before results; no tuning on evaluation

restrictions: No phase or reward-rule labels given to learner; benchmark scoring sees simulator private goals
Only public context/raw tokens + own chosen event and terminal boolean to learner
All methods get same train episode count and reward for their chosen action
No D3/D4 claim on familiar fixed context/label priors
Previously inspected seed cohorts are not blind
No default deployment, automatic permissions or private records
